office_does: The county assessor lists and values all taxable property in Asotin County each year, the basis for property tax bills.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Jenny L. Rynearson, in office since 2016, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Asotin County Assessor since 2016 and a past president of the state county assessors' association, running unopposed for another term.
highlights: Assessor since 2016; Southeast Washington chair and past president of the state assessors' association [S1]
Served on the Clean Energy Project Tax Impact Task Force and supported HB 1960 on taxing wind and solar projects [S1]
